CustomField.label: Partner Type
CustomField.description: Free-text partner track requested on the public partner-application form. Deliberately NOT a picklist: applicants type whatever they call themselves. LeadPartnerProvisioningHandler maps it leniently onto Account.PartnerType__c, which IS a restricted picklist (Solution/Referral), and records every guess on the Partner Provisioning Log. Retrofitted into source control because the Lead-conversion trigger compiles against this field - without it a fresh scratch org fails with an unhelpful "Invalid field" error.
